name: statecraft
description: An open-source geopolitics simulator played in plain text on a live world map.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w @statecraft/server" "npm run dev -w @statecraft/web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @statecraft/server -- --open
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
